scope.statement: Web UIの挙動、状態、入力、失敗、アクセシビリティ、性能を、比較可能で再実行可能な実験として証明する。
exclusions: 静的な見た目だけを示し、利用者操作や失敗条件を検証しないデザイン見本
特定ブランドの素材、文言、画面構成、演出順序を再現する実装

targets.title: Easing and duration
targets.rationale: Timing vocabulary is a prerequisite for comparing nearly every time-based interface transition.

targets.title: Enter and exit transition
targets.rationale: Elements entering and leaving while preserving semantic state is a universal interface behavior.

targets.title: Staggered orchestration
targets.rationale: Ordered multi-element timing needs a reusable contract distinct from styling or content.

targets.title: Layout FLIP transition
targets.rationale: Layout changes need continuity without confusing layout ownership with transform-only decoration.

targets.title: Shared-element navigation
targets.rationale: Cross-view continuity needs explicit navigation, focus, history, and fallback behavior.

targets.title: Viewport reveal
targets.rationale: Visibility-triggered disclosure is common and must keep information available without animation.

targets.title: Scroll progress timeline
targets.rationale: Continuous scroll progress is a separate contract from threshold-based viewport entry.

targets.title: Sticky and pinned region
targets.rationale: Pinned regions change scroll and focus expectations and therefore need lifecycle and composition evidence.

targets.title: Magnetic target response
targets.rationale: Pointer attraction exposes proximity, damping, spring, keyboard equivalence, and reduced-motion decisions.

targets.title: Drag to reorder
targets.rationale: Reordering combines direct manipulation, keyboard alternatives, announcements, and persistent state.

targets.title: Momentum and inertia
targets.rationale: Velocity after release requires deterministic bounds, cancellation, and input-independent outcomes.

targets.title: Modal disclosure and dismissal
targets.rationale: Modal transitions are only correct when focus, dismissal, background isolation, and semantic state agree.

targets.title: Accordion disclosure
targets.rationale: Expandable sections test intrinsic-size transitions, semantics, focus, and no-motion equivalence.

targets.title: SVG path drawing
targets.rationale: Path-length animation provides a deterministic SVG baseline with clear masking and fallback behavior.

targets.title: Shape morphing
targets.rationale: Morphing requires compatible geometry, deterministic interpolation, and an honest fallback for unsupported shapes.

targets.title: Mask and clip reveal
targets.rationale: Mask-based disclosure must be distinguished from semantic hiding and preserve a readable fallback.

targets.title: Loading and determinate progress
targets.rationale: Waiting feedback must distinguish unknown duration, known progress, completion, failure, and reduced motion.

targets.title: Status and notification feedback
targets.rationale: Transient status needs timing, queueing, dismissal, focus restraint, and assistive-technology announcements.

targets.title: Hover, focus, active, selected, and disabled feedback
targets.rationale: Control feedback must distinguish transient input states from persistent selection and unavailable actions without relying on motion or color alone.

targets.title: Tooltip and non-modal popover positioning
targets.rationale: Anchored disclosure needs collision avoidance, dismissal, hover and focus persistence, touch alternatives, and semantic ownership.

targets.title: Menu and submenu navigation
targets.rationale: Menus combine roving focus, typeahead, pointer aim, nested dismissal, placement, and restoration across multiple input paths.

targets.title: Combobox and asynchronous autocomplete
targets.rationale: Autocomplete must coordinate text editing, selection, asynchronous results, cancellation, announcements, and empty or failed states.

targets.title: Tabs and roving focus
targets.rationale: Tabbed interfaces need orientation-aware key behavior, selected state, focus strategy, overflow handling, and stable panel relationships.

targets.title: Carousel and snap-point navigation
targets.rationale: Carousels must preserve content order and controls while reconciling native scroll, snap points, drag, autoplay policy, and slide announcements.

targets.title: Swipe action reveal and commit
targets.rationale: Swipe actions need directional intent thresholds, scroll conflict resolution, cancellation, accessible buttons, and reversible destructive outcomes.

targets.title: Pan, zoom, and rotate manipulation
targets.rationale: Two-dimensional manipulation needs gesture arbitration, focal-point math, keyboard controls, finite bounds, reset, and readable zoom outcomes.

targets.title: Range, toggle, and lasso selection
targets.rationale: Multi-selection requires visible ownership, modifier-independent touch paths, keyboard range semantics, geometry updates, and non-destructive cancellation.

targets.title: Resize handles and split panes
targets.rationale: Resizable regions need geometry constraints, semantic separators, keyboard increments, pointer capture, responsive persistence, and reset behavior.

targets.title: Command palette and shortcut routing
targets.rationale: Command discovery combines global shortcut ownership, modal focus, fuzzy results, nested scopes, action status, and conflict avoidance with browser keys.

targets.title: Optimistic action, rollback, and undo
targets.rationale: Optimistic feedback needs pending, committed, failed, superseded, cancelled, and undo states that remain understandable under network races.

targets.title: Bounded parallax and depth cues
targets.rationale: Parallax needs finite amplitude, layer ownership, resize-safe geometry, reduced-motion replacement, and protection against obscuring reading order.

targets.title: Discrete scrollytelling step activation
targets.rationale: Step-driven stories need deterministic thresholds, deep links, reverse traversal, focus-safe navigation, and a linear no-script reading order.

targets.title: Horizontal narrative scene
targets.rationale: Horizontal scenes must not hijack vertical input, hide focus, break browser navigation, or make content unreachable without scripted pinning.

targets.title: Pinned scene orchestration
targets.rationale: Composed pinned sequences need explicit scroll ownership, nested timeline boundaries, resize recovery, skip controls, and release behavior.

targets.title: Video and audio timeline scrubbing
targets.rationale: Media scrubbing must separate preview from committed seek, expose time semantics, handle buffering, and preserve captions and keyboard controls.

targets.title: Image sequence and frame playback
targets.rationale: Frame sequences need bounded preloading, deterministic indexing, responsive source selection, missing-frame recovery, and a static representative fallback.

targets.title: Kinetic typography timeline
targets.rationale: Animated type must preserve selectable semantic text, line wrapping, language expansion, reading order, motion limits, and forced-color legibility.

targets.title: Line, word, and character text reveal
targets.rationale: Split-text reveals must avoid duplicate accessibility trees, survive responsive reflow, restore original DOM, and expose the complete text without motion.

targets.title: Variable font axis interpolation
targets.rationale: Font-axis motion needs valid axis bounds, fallback fonts, layout-shift accounting, language coverage, and reduced-motion simplification.

targets.title: Chapter progress and deep-link navigation
targets.rationale: Long-form progress needs semantic landmarks, active-section tracking, history ownership, focus placement, and stable behavior under dynamic content.

targets.title: Spatial zoom and drill-down transition
targets.rationale: Zooming between overview and detail needs stable semantic navigation, bounded scale, transformed focus visibility, history, and a non-zoom fallback.

targets.title: Composed narrative reference case
targets.rationale: A complete original story must prove that atomic timelines, media, pinning, typography, navigation, and fallbacks compose without conflicting ownership.

targets.title: Canvas sprite and fixed-step game loop
targets.rationale: A sprite loop establishes deterministic time stepping, input decoupling, DPR scaling, pause, resize, and static fallback for Canvas rendering.

targets.title: Interactive Canvas data visualization
targets.rationale: Canvas charts need hit testing, keyboard and table alternatives, resize, zoom, deterministic data, text clarity, and accessible selection outcomes.

targets.title: OffscreenCanvas worker rendering
targets.rationale: Worker rendering must prove transfer ownership, message backpressure, resize synchronization, termination, capability fallback, and deterministic capture.

targets.title: Seeded particle emitter
targets.rationale: Particle effects need seeded generation, bounded counts, emission and decay phases, reduced-motion replacement, pooling, pause, and cleanup evidence.

targets.title: Flocking and autonomous agent system
targets.rationale: Multi-agent motion exposes spatial partitioning, deterministic seeds, parameter control, frame budgets, pause behavior, and simplified fallbacks.

targets.title: Collision and constraint physics world
targets.rationale: A physics world needs fixed stepping, collision and constraint stability, deterministic reset, input mapping, sleep, boundary, and teardown behavior.

targets.title: WebGL scene and context lifecycle
targets.rationale: The WebGL baseline must cover renderer creation, DPR, resize, context loss and restore, offscreen pause, disposal, and semantic fallback.

targets.title: Shader uniform and material transition
targets.rationale: Shader-driven effects need normalized uniforms, precision and capability fallbacks, color-space decisions, deterministic time, and bounded visual risk.

targets.title: Post-processing and multi-pass pipeline
targets.rationale: Multi-pass graphics need quality tiers, framebuffer resize and disposal, color-space consistency, capability fallback, and measured GPU cost.

targets.title: Three-dimensional camera navigation
targets.rationale: 3D camera motion needs bounded orbit and dolly controls, focusable alternatives, orientation cues, reduced motion, clipping safety, and reset.

targets.title: GPU instancing and large-scene scaling
targets.rationale: Instanced scenes must demonstrate culling, picking, deterministic data, quality degradation, buffer updates, and resource disposal at scale.

targets.title: WebGPU compute and rendering fallback
targets.rationale: WebGPU coverage must include adapter and device failure, deterministic compute, buffer cleanup, error scopes, WebGL or Canvas fallback, and honest compatibility evidence.

targets.title: Lottie playback and fallback lifecycle
targets.rationale: Authored vector playback needs segment control, reduced-motion frames, asset provenance, renderer choice, offscreen pause, cleanup, and static fallback.

targets.title: Rive interactive state machine
targets.rationale: Interactive vector runtimes need named input mapping, semantic controls, deterministic states, reduced motion, runtime disposal, provenance, and non-runtime fallback.

targets.title: Audio spectrum and waveform visualization
targets.rationale: Audio visualization needs explicit user activation, deterministic signal fixtures, pause and disconnect cleanup, non-audio meaning, and reduced visual intensity.

targets.title: Audio transport and synchronized controls
targets.rationale: Audio controls must handle autoplay policy, play promises, seek, buffering, rate, ended state, media keys, transcripts, and teardown.

targets.title: Video player, captions, and playback state
targets.rationale: Custom video surfaces need native-equivalent controls, captions, fullscreen fallback, buffering, picture-in-picture decisions, focus, and media-session cleanup.

targets.title: Streaming data chart and backpressure
targets.rationale: Live visualization needs batching, windowing, pause, stale indication, reconnect, announcement throttling, deterministic streams, and tabular alternatives.

targets.title: Offline, reconnect, retry, and stale-data recovery
targets.rationale: Network resilience needs deterministic disconnects, queued work, retry policy, stale provenance, conflict handling, announcements, and restored focus.

targets.title: Realtime presence and collaborator cursors
targets.rationale: Presence indicators need identity-independent fixtures, interpolation, stale expiry, connection loss, viewport mapping, privacy limits, and non-visual summaries.

targets.title: Idle, away, and resumed state
targets.rationale: Idle behavior must avoid surveillance assumptions, distinguish document visibility from user absence, pause background work, and recover without lost state.

targets.title: Device motion and orientation response
targets.rationale: Sensor-driven motion needs explicit permission, calibrated deterministic mocks, finite ranges, orientation changes, manual controls, reduced motion, and listener cleanup.

targets.title: Camera permission and preview lifecycle
targets.rationale: Camera use needs pre-permission explanation, denial and unavailable states, deterministic mock frames, visible activity, track shutdown, and privacy review.

targets.title: Microphone permission and level meter
targets.rationale: Microphone feedback needs consent, denial, deterministic audio fixtures, rate-limited visual and semantic levels, clipping indication, and complete node and track cleanup.

targets.title: Background synchronization status
targets.rationale: Background work needs queued, syncing, paused, conflicted, failed, and complete states without false precision, focus theft, or excessive announcements.

targets.title: Reactive data diff and continuity
targets.rationale: Changing data should preserve identity, indicate insertions and removals, prevent layout confusion, batch announcements, and remain readable without animation.

targets.title: Permission and capability state orchestration
targets.rationale: Capability requests need preflight explanation, user initiation, denied and unavailable paths, revocation recovery, least privilege, and deterministic mocks.

targets.title: Responsive viewport and container resilience
targets.rationale: Published behaviors must survive viewport, container, orientation, dynamic viewport, safe-area, and embedded-frame changes without clipped outcomes.

targets.title: Reduced-motion and no-motion equivalence
targets.rationale: Every motion-bearing behavior needs a declared disable, simplify, replace, or user-control strategy that preserves the same information and task outcome.

targets.title: Contrast, zoom, reflow, and forced colors
targets.rationale: Visual reference quality requires automated and human evidence at high zoom, text spacing, forced colors, light and dark schemes, and non-color cues.

targets.title: Internationalization, RTL, and writing modes
targets.rationale: Behaviors must preserve logical direction, focus order, gesture meaning, content expansion, segmentation, and motion semantics across languages and writing modes.

targets.title: SSR, hydration, and initial-state continuity
targets.rationale: Framework integrations must avoid hydration mismatch, double animation, hidden server content, layout shift, duplicated listeners, and inconsistent motion preferences.

targets.title: Lifecycle and resource cleanup
targets.rationale: Stable variants must prove removal of frames, observers, timers, events, workers, media tracks, audio nodes, histories, GPU objects, and generated DOM.

targets.title: Offscreen and background suspension
targets.rationale: Continuous work must pause when hidden or offscreen, preserve elapsed-time semantics, resume without jumps, and avoid unnecessary battery and thermal cost.

targets.title: Performance, memory, and energy budgets
targets.rationale: Performance evidence must cover frame pacing, long tasks, bundle and asset cost, memory growth, DPR, quality scaling, offscreen work, and reproducible environment context.

targets.title: Browser compatibility and evidence expiry
targets.rationale: Compatibility claims need browser and platform matrices, fallback tests, verification dates, scheduled expiry, and automatic maturity reduction when evidence becomes stale.

targets.title: Deployment security and capability grants
targets.rationale: Public execution needs verified origin separation, CSP, sandbox, permissions, network denial, source validation, deployment headers, capability review, and incident rollback.

targets.title: Provenance, originality, and publication rights
targets.rationale: Every public artifact needs original implementation review, code and asset licenses, font and media provenance, reference boundaries, trademark review, and removable disputed content.

targets.title: Contribution admission and review pipeline
targets.rationale: Untrusted contributions need schema validation, dependency and license checks, isolated execution, artifact regeneration, human review, provenance attestations, and rejection reasons.

targets.title: Deterministic visual regression evidence
targets.rationale: Visual evidence needs stable fonts, viewport, DPR, seed, media, state, motion mode, source hashes, harness hashes, diff thresholds, and reviewable diagnostics.

targets.title: Agent retrieval, implementation, and review evals
targets.rationale: Agent Skills need multilingual intent retrieval, negative routing, constraint-aware selection, correct adaptation, lifecycle review, accessibility review, and originality eval thresholds.

targets.title: Dependency, engine, and version policy
targets.rationale: Library comparisons need pinned reproducible versions, lockfile review, bundle attribution, security and license policy, upgrade cadence, and archived-version handling.

targets.title: Learning paths and reproducible releases
targets.rationale: A public reference needs prerequisite graphs, concise and deep explanations, runnable exercises, versioned snapshots, changelogs, migration notes, and reproducible package distribution.

router.description: Web UI挙動の8 Outcomeを、Domain正本、既存Coverage、実行証拠へ段階的に案内する単一Router。
